mapper.sql: P.PLAN_ID, P.TITLE, R.REGION_NAME, P.START_DATE, P.END_DATE, P.VISIBILITY, P.PUBLISH_STATUS, P.PLAN_STATUS, P.VERSION_NO, CASE WHEN P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} THEN 'CREATOR' ELSE 'INVITEE' END AS CURRENT_MEMBER_ROLE, P.UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TRAVEL_PLAN P JOIN REGION_MASTER R ON R.REGION_CODE = P.REGION_CODE WHERE ( P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PLAN_MEMBER PM WHERE PM.PLAN_ID = P.PLAN_ID AND PM.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND PM.PARTICIPANT_TYPE = 'INVITEE' ) ) AND (P.PLAN_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' OR P.OWNER_MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) ORDER BY P.UPDATED_AT DESC, P.PLAN_ID DESC
